g.title: Mond–Smith–van Straten give eight isolated full-space rank-three stochastic factorizations. The repository's audited scalar-dynamics lift transfers this finiteness to minimal continuous-time positive realizations.
Continuous-time positive realizability uses invariant polyhedral cones; PH literature constructs dynamic invariant triangles and ordered Coxian polytopes.
Normalized similarities and positivity constraints describe complete same-order realization sets under the relevant minimality assumptions; their semialgebraicity is established.
The balanced theta family has unbounded, two-point, then singleton entropy fibers across an exact quartic threshold.
For one resolved pair, a finite local entropy ceiling exists exactly at N=2 or a complete N=3 triangle.
A uniquely identified minimal-three-state tree is approached by same-trace, rate-bounded triangles with divergent entropy.
Aggregated CTMCs can share observations while differing in detailed balance; discrete-time masked models already show broad entropy variation and sampled growth near one-way boundaries.
Vanishing reverse rates can cause logarithmic entropy divergence; arbitrarily small total variation can coexist with arbitrarily large KL divergence.
Converging experiment laws with diverging parameter size force uniformly valid confidence sets or upper limits to become unbounded.
The narrow publication case is the exhaustive two-point physical entropy fiber and sharp balanced transition, together with the all-N resolved-pair local-ceiling criterion.

No inspected source was shown to imply the exact two-point physical entropy fiber or the complete fixed-N ceiling criterion; matching exceptional results in inaccessible originals remain a specific risk.
The inspected abstract reports canonical aggregate representations under regularity conditions, but the original hypotheses and exceptional examples remain unread.
